failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, role-graph, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id (a new generation attempt id AND a new native_contact_fit run and attempt id); a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. A response whose delivered content carries a reasoning marker is a failure of the read, not of a row: it stops the flight (reasoning_content_guard). A partial manifest is never scored and never read.
